note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; Codex was out of credits — both codex.py attempts failed). One major, four minors. «The translation is close and faithful throughout … The one real fault is 'ilusões' for 'illusionibus', which in this Latin means mockeries.» Passed: 37:2 (= 6:2), 'ficaram cravadas', 'firmastes … se firmaram sobre mim', 'diante da vossa ira', 'cicatrizes', 'lombos', 'sem medida', 'repreensões', 'Para que não', 'me difamavam', 'Atendei em meu auxílio'. Pointing marks confirmed.

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: illúsio is mockery (ἐμπαιγμῶν); 'ilusões' changes the sense → 'escárnios'
minor: stetérunt is 'stood', 'se detiveram' adds halting → 'e ficaram de pé'
minor: the same → 'ficaram de longe'
minor: *a gémitu* is cause, 'com' is accompaniment → 'pelo gemido'
minor: 'à minha custa' adds profiting → 'exultem sobre mim'
outcomes.reason: The super me row (29:2, 34:19, 34:24): supergaudére → *alegrar-se à minha custa*; *exultar* is exsultáre's and *sobre mim* after joy is heard 'about me'. The blind reader heard gloating first. Option 3.

note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; run by the coordinator, Codex being out of quota). Nine verses, eleven remarks; best 37:5 (*como um fardo pesado pesaram sobre mim*), worst 37:17. «The psalm mostly sounds like prayer in Portuguese … The weak spots are a few false friends (ilusões, vaidades, meditavam) and some calqued syntax in the middle verses (12, 17, 23).» Four taken (two in part), seven refused with options.

outcomes.remark: 'ilusões' heard as daydreams → 'escárnios'
drop the article: 'Meu coração'
outcomes.reason: The glossary keeps the article before possessives.

outcomes.remark: 'Os amigos meus e os próximos meus' calqued → 'Os meus amigos e os meus vizinhos'
outcomes.reason: In part: the plain order taken (proparoxytone mediant accepted); *vizinhos* refused — vicínus's word, and it drops the echo *próximos … aproximaram*; an option.

outcomes.remark: 'se detiveram de longe' unidiomatic → 'ao longe'
outcomes.reason: Mended otherwise, with the Latinist's *ficaram de longe*.

outcomes.remark: 'vaidades' heard as pride → 'coisas vãs'
outcomes.reason: vánitas row; *coisas vãs* is inánia / vana's (2:1, 11:3). Evidence to the row.

outcomes.remark: 'meditavam enganos' devotional → 'tramavam'
outcomes.reason: The meditári row keeps the Latin's one verb for the just man and the plotter (2:1, 35:5); *tramar* explains.

outcomes.remark: 'repreensões' heavy → 'réplicas'
outcomes.reason: The echo with 37:2 (ἐλέγξῃς / ἐλεγμούς) is the Latin's; the blind reader heard a sense within the word.

outcomes.remark: worst line: 'Para que não' awkward in direct speech; subject inverted → 'Que os meus inimigos não exultem sobre mim'
outcomes.reason: In part: *Que os meus inimigos não se alegrem à minha custa* — the wish and the order taken; *exultem sobre mim* refused (super me row; exsultáre's verb), option 3.

outcomes.remark: 'são abalados' heavy passive → 'vacilam'
outcomes.reason: The Latin's passive and the movéri row; heard rightly.

outcomes.remark: 'falaram grandezas' unidiomatic → 'grandes coisas'
outcomes.reason: 34:26b and 11:4 say *grandezas*; the three change together or not at all — evidence to the glossary.

outcomes.remark: 'minha … minha', 'à minha vista' stiff → 'diante de mim'
outcomes.reason: The conspéctus row (15:8); *diante de* already renders a fácie three times here.

outcomes.remark: 'Atender em' not Portuguese → 'Acudi em meu auxílio'
outcomes.reason: D3 inténdere → *atender*; the blind reader heard 'come to my help' first. The formula (= 69:2) proposed as an open row.

note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; blind/prayed.vos.json only). 37 items, 4 unknown words (lombos, insensatez, grandezas as boasts, vaidades as empty words). Heard rightly or within the Latin's range: *ultrapassaram a minha cabeça* (more than I can bear), *nem ela está comigo*, *faziam violência*, *procuravam males contra mim*, *esperei* (hope or wait), *anunciarei* (confess), *se firmaram sobre mim* (gained the upper hand), *retribuem males por bens*, *porque eu seguia a bondade*, *Atendei em meu auxílio* (come to my help, first).

outcomes.remark: 'cheios de ilusões' heard as fantasies, puzzling with loins
outcomes.reason: *escárnios* (the Latinist's major).

outcomes.remark: 'lombos' unknown; heard as the lower back
outcomes.reason: The organ the Latin names (rule 5); passed the Latinist and the stylist; *entranhas* the option.

outcomes.remark: 'se detiveram' may be heard as 'were detained'; how coming near and stopping is hostile is unclear
outcomes.reason: *ficaram de pé* (the Latinist).

outcomes.remark: 'Para que não …' heard as a purpose clause; what was said is unclear
outcomes.reason: The wish *Que … não*.

outcomes.remark: 'grandezas' not heard as boasts
outcomes.reason: 34:26b, 11:4; evidence to the glossary.

outcomes.remark: 'vaidades' heard as pride / boasting
outcomes.reason: vánitas row (4:3, 30:7); evidence to the row.

outcomes.remark: 'meditavam enganos' — prayerful verb; 'engano' as mistake
outcomes.reason: Heard 'thought up deceptions' first; meditári and dolus rows.

outcomes.remark: 'diante da vossa ira / dos meus pecados' heard as 'in front of', not as cause
outcomes.reason: One of the two senses a fácie holds; the Latinist passed it; *por causa de* is option 1.

outcomes.remark: 'cicatrizes' that rot is puzzling; 'diante da minha insensatez' heard as 'in front of'
outcomes.reason: The Latin's word and picture; *chagas* the option.

outcomes.remark: 'curvado até o fim' heard temporal; 'miserável' may colour as 'despicable'
outcomes.reason: usque in finem → *até o fim* (15:11); DRB 'even to the end'. *miserável* is Matos Soares 1932's word for miser.

outcomes.remark: 'eu rugia' a surprising image
outcomes.reason: The Latin's (and Greek's) roar, kept (rule 5).

outcomes.remark: 'buscavam a minha alma' heard spiritually
outcomes.reason: The ánima mea row (53:5, 34:4): kept, *vida* the known option.

outcomes.remark: 'repreensões' heard as 'does not scold others'
outcomes.reason: Within the word (he gives no reproof back); the echo with 37:2.

outcomes.remark: 'a luz dos meus olhos' may be heard as the idiom for a beloved person
outcomes.reason: Eyesight was the first hearing; the Latin's words.

outcomes.remark: 'insensatez' unknown
outcomes.reason: insipiéntia → *insensatez* (row; 21:3).

note: ps037/revise_v2.py: 37:8 *escárnios* (Latinist MAJOR, the stylist, the blind reader); 37:12 / 12b *ficaram de pé … ficaram de longe* (Latinist minors; *detiveram* heard as arrest); 37:9 *pelo gemido* (Latinist minor); 37:12 plain order *Os meus amigos e os meus próximos* (the stylist); 37:17 *Que os meus inimigos não se alegrem à minha custa* (the stylist's worst line; the blind reader heard a purpose clause). Refused with options: *Meu coração*, *coisas vãs*, *tramavam*, *réplicas*, *vacilam*, *grandes coisas*, *diante de mim*, *Acudi*, *exultem sobre mim*.

Draft 2: hard pass. 37:12 now ends its first colon on the proparoxytone *próximos* (accepted — the plain order, the stylist); 37:17 first colon 22 syllables for the Latin's 20. Other flags as draft 1; rhyme 37:14 / 37:15 (*boca*) is the Latin's *os suum … in ore suo*.
